final.memo:
We are initiating a position in the Company, a large-scale oil and gas producer centered in the Permian Basin [D01]. We understand this business well, as it is a core resource provider that remains an essential component of the American economy [D01].

The Company possesses the largest acreage footprint in the Permian, allowing for significant scale advantages as production costs have trended lower [D01]. While historical net income has been volatile due to past impairments, the business currently generates significant free cash flow, breaking even at approximately $40 WTI [D01, D02].

Management has demonstrated a commendable shift in capital allocation, prioritizing the reduction of total debt toward a $20 billion target over the pursuit of growth for growth's sake [D01]. We trust the current leadership to maintain this discipline, especially as they balance debt repayment with dividends and modest production growth [D01].

The market appears to focus on historical cyclicality and leverage concerns, ignoring the strength of the current free-cash-flow yield of 18.5% [D01, D04]. With the long bond yield at 1.83%, the current price offers a significant margin of safety relative to our estimate of intrinsic value [D04].

Our holding serves as a permanent, passive investment in a business that rides a necessary long-term economic tailwind [D04, D08]. We are building this position toward 10% of our equity portfolio, mindful that our patience provides the edge needed to navigate commodity price cycles [D04, D08].
